clue.text: One's likely to budget for inexpensive fish

parts.note: inexpensive means cheap
the skate is a flat fish

explanation.surface: Someone who keeps to a budget is likely to choose an inexpensive fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A miser counts every penny, so such a person is the sort likely to budget hard.

clue.text: It precedes the final passion

definitions.meaning: in sport a qualifying round comes before the final
passion means intense feeling or ardour

explanation.definitionFit: A qualifying round run before a final is so called, and the word also means fervour or ardour.

clue.text: Cause of breathing difficulty found? Hats off to mother!

indicators.note: off suggests the letters of hats are thrown out of order

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: A doctor finds why someone is wheezing and salutes the patient's mother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hats off' reads as a salute, but 'off' is the anagram signal working on the word before it; 'found?' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A chronic lung condition that narrows the airways is a common cause of wheezing and breathlessness.

clue.text: The woman has to ring up for varnish

parts.note: the woman is she

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word call is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to ring someone is to call them

explanation.surface: A woman has to telephone to order some varnish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns CALL into LLAC in this down entry; 'has to' and 'for' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: This resin from the lac insect is dissolved in alcohol to make a hard glossy varnish.

clue.text: Foreign port area

definitions.meaning: A port city in northern Israel
a unit of land area of 4,840 square yards

explanation.definitionFit: It names an ancient Israeli harbour town and also a traditional measure of land area.

clue.text: Tips that I've cut for salad

indicators.note: I've cuts into the word for tips, so it sits inside

parts.note: tips are ends
taken as written without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: Ends of a vegetable trimmed off for a salad.
explanation.definitionFit: These bitter leafy chicories are a classic salad vegetable, standing for salad greens.

clue.text: Hire candle out, giving superior illumination

indicators.note: out signals the letters of hire and candle are put out of order

explanation.surface: Renting candles instead of a better light fitting.
explanation.definitionFit: A hanging branched light fitting gives illumination from above, superior in the sense of higher up.

clue.text: Smart girl seen in a city

parts.note: smart in the fashionable sense means chic
Hester is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A fashionable young woman is spotted somewhere in town.
explanation.walkthrough: CHICHESTER is a cathedral city in West Sussex, southern England.
explanation.definitionFit: This cathedral city in West Sussex is a city in southern England.

clue.text: Hash settled for Middle Eastern ruler

indicators.note: settled implies the jumbled letters of hash are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A muddle resolved by a Middle Eastern monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: The title was used by the monarch of Iran before the 1979 revolution.

clue.text: Neat electrical network that keeps farm animals in a field

definitions.text: that keeps farm animals in a field

parts.note: neat is an old word for cattle
the national grid is the electrical supply network

explanation.surface: A tidy wiring system used on a farm to keep animals penned in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Neat' looks like tidy, but it is the old word for oxen; a cattle grid is a set of bars over a ditch that hooves cannot cross.
explanation.definitionFit: Bars set over a pit in a gateway stop livestock crossing, keeping them in their field.

clue.text: Architectural style about right? That's sarcastic!

indicators.note: the style is placed about, that is around, the letter for right

parts.note: Ionic is one of the classical orders of architecture

explanation.surface: Asking whether a classical architectural style is correct draws a sarcastic retort.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying the opposite of what one means is a mocking, sarcastic manner of speech.

clue.text: Not birds, but they chirp and fly

definitions.text: Not birds, but they chirp and fly

parts.words: Not birds, but they chirp and fly
parts.note: chirping and flying suggest birds, but these are insects that make a loud shrill song

explanation.definitionFit: These large insects fly and make a loud chirring noise, so they chirp without being birds.

clue.text: Flying saucer?

parts.note: not a UFO but a saucer-shaped disc flung into the air as a shooting target

explanation.definitionFit: The disc launched as a target in trap shooting is shaped like a saucer and flies through the air.

clue.text: Chars at night to get debt written off

parts.note: a char is a cleaner, so chars means cleans
late means at a late hour, at night

explanation.surface: Cleaning ladies working after dark have their debts cancelled.
explanation.walkthrough: A char is a British cleaning lady; 'to get' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A fresh start with past debts or offences wiped away is an idiom from wiping a slate clean.

clue.text: Where we can buy with money off drink on board

definitions.text: Where we can buy with money off

indicators.note: on, as in on board, puts the drink inside the ship's letters

parts.note: the board here is a ship; SS is a steamship
ale is a drink

explanation.surface: A bar on a cruise ship where you pay discounted prices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' conventionally means inside SS, the steamship.
explanation.definitionFit: Shop events with reduced prices are where shoppers can purchase goods at a discount.

clue.text: Traveller allowed key is satisfied

parts.note: a commercial traveller is a sales rep
allowed means let
E is a musical key

explanation.surface: A travelling salesman given permission is content.
explanation.definitionFit: Being filled to the full after eating, sated, is being satisfied.

clue.text: Splits payments for accommodation

definitions.meaning: money paid regularly to a landlord

explanation.definitionFit: The word means tears in cloth and also the regular sums tenants pay for housing.

clue.text: Bags of patients

definitions.meaning: a doctor's patients are referred to as ...

explanation.definitionFit: Luggage items are suitcases, and a doctor speaks of individual patients as cases.

clue.text: Champions of the pack

definitions.meaning: the cards ranking highest in a pack of cards

explanation.definitionFit: Star performers are so called, and the four top-ranking cards in a deck bear that name.

clue.text: Pay attention or bend over

definitions.meaning: a ship leaning to one side

explanation.definitionFit: An old word for listen, and also a ship's lean or tilt to one side.

clue.text: Starts the game off with defeats

definitions.meaning: beaters on a shoot flush out game birds by beating the undergrowth

explanation.definitionFit: Shoot beaters flush out game birds, and the word also means overcomes in a contest.

clue.text: What this youngster's mother did?

parts.note: read as a verb phrase, the young animal's mother gave birth to it, so she bore her offspring

explanation.definitionFit: A young ursine animal; split as a phrase it says what its mother did in giving birth.

clue.text: Phrases articulated by Himalayans

indicators.note: articulated, as in jointed, suggests the letters of phrases are reassembled

explanation.definitionFit: These people of Nepal living high in the Himalaya are famed as mountain guides.

clue.text: Arrests for minor assaults?

definitions.meaning: to pinch is slang for to arrest
a nip between finger and thumb is a small attack

explanation.definitionFit: Slang for police arrests, and also small nips with finger and thumb, playfully called assaults.

clue.text: He fleeces his clients

parts.note: sounds like a swindler, but he literally removes the wool from sheep

explanation.definitionFit: A sheep clipper removes the fleece from the animals he works on.

clue.text: A capital rank Arab holds

indicators.note: the words rank Arab hold the capital within them

explanation.surface: A high-ranking Arab is in charge of a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: This city is the capital of Turkey.

clue.text: After a drive, one walks

parts.note: drive suggests a car, but it is the long shot off the tee, after which the player walks the fairway

explanation.definitionFit: A player of the links hits a drive and then walks after the ball.

clue.text: Time to come up before a court

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means era is read from the bottom

parts.note: an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: Time for someone to appear before a court of law.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to come up' is the reversal signal in this down entry; 'before' is a link. In Britain an area is the sunken yard in front of a basement, a kind of court.
explanation.definitionFit: An enclosed open space, such as a courtyard or basement yard, can be called a court.

clue.text: Electric wire to act as a conductor

explanation.definitionFit: A flex for an appliance bears the name, and it also means to guide or conduct others.

clue.text: One holds hands during the game

definitions.text: One holds hands during the game

parts.words: One holds hands during the game
parts.note: suggests romance, but the hands are sets of cards held at bridge or whist

explanation.definitionFit: Someone at bridge or poker holds hands of cards throughout play.

clue.text: Growth of love at first sight

parts.note: love is zero, O, in tennis
taken as written

indicators.note: first means only the opening letter of sight is used

explanation.definitionFit: A cereal crop is a growth in a field, and sowing wild ones is youthful growth.

clue.text: Metal shackles — they keep men in step

parts.note: brass is a metal alloy
bands are bonds or shackles

explanation.surface: Metal fetters keep prisoners marching in line.
explanation.definitionFit: Groups of musicians playing brass instruments provide marching music so soldiers keep in step.
